description: Header file defining the MultiThreadedCertVerifier class, which implements a multi-threaded certificate verifier in the net namespace, including class declarations, method signatures, and internal data members.

classes.name: MultiThreadedCertVerifier
classes.description: A class implementing a multi-threaded certificate verifier that runs synchronous verification on worker threads, with methods for verification, configuration, observer management, and updating verification procedures.

methods.name: MultiThreadedCertVerifier
methods.description: Constructor initializing the verifier with verification procedure and factory.

methods.description: Adds an observer to the verifier.
